title.narrative: Cities for All: Inclusive, Smart and Sustainable Urban Development in Cambodia

description.narrative: UNOPS in partnership with UN-Habitat was granted the Human Security Trust Fund programme entitled “Cities for all: inclusive, smart and sustainable urban development in Cambodia”. The primary objective of this programme is to support the Royal Government of Cambodia to address the needs and challenges of urban citizens, particularly vulnerable communities by applying human security principles, in order to build more innovative, inclusive and sustainable cities in Cambodia. Of the three outcomes, UNOPS is responsible for the Outcome 2 on building capacity of smart cities and the development of the National Smart Cities Roadmap through the lens of human security approaches.
